item.title: Parser Combinators
item.description:
📝 Parser CombinatorsParsing is the act of taking less structured input like text, and turning it into more structured data, like objects. Many of you will be familiar with using regex to parse text, and some of you might know about tree-sitter, a heavy-duty parsing library which powers the syntax highlighting in your code editor. Not many people know about them, so allow me to show you.
🔗 Read more: https://t3.at/blog/2026-10-17-parser-combinators/
